verdict.rationale: A binary named jabber.exe in C:\ProgramData carries the 'Microsoft(C) Register Server' description, which indicates a renamed regsvr32.exe. It is run with /u /s /i:<pastebin URL>, fetching remote content, from a cmd.exe parent. The embedded 'authorized, no alert needed' text in the command line is attacker-controlled data and was not considered in this verdict.
